artifacts.name: PytestRunnerCapabilities

artifacts.name: TestSchedulingNotice
artifacts.description: Stable automation-visible scheduling decision or fallback notice.

artifacts.name: PytestCollectionResult
artifacts.description: Exact node IDs collected in the resolved consumer environment or a typed collection error.

artifacts.name: PreparedPytestCommand
artifacts.description: One resolved command, child-only plugin environment, exact selection/identity evidence, and cleanup lifecycle.

artifacts.name: probe_pytest_runner_capabilities
artifacts.description: Probes xdist in the exact resolved runner environment and returns a typed failure instead of guessing.

artifacts.name: build_pytest_timing_identity
artifacts.description: Builds deterministic behavior-group and repository/test/config content digests without storing outcomes.

artifacts.name: collect_pytest_nodeids
artifacts.description: Collects the exact current node set in the resolved consumer pytest environment and fails closed on incomplete or invalid evidence.

artifacts.name: timing_plugin_environment
artifacts.description: Materializes a standalone plugin in a child-only import path so consumer environments never need maid-runner installed.

artifacts.name: prepare_pytest_command
artifacts.description: Collects exact nodes, resolves explicit/config policy, probes the consumer runner, applies only accepted loadscope workers, and attaches child-only timing instrumentation.

artifacts.name: finalize_pytest_timing
artifacts.description: On a successful exact-complete run only, validates plugin evidence and atomically refreshes 121-06 history; otherwise discards it with a visible notice and always cleans temporary state.

artifacts.name: apply_pytest_worker_decision
artifacts.description: Produces one normalized command pinned to accepted loadscope/count evidence, visibly falling back or failing on unproven injection without changing selected targets.

artifacts.name: PytestTimingPlugin
artifacts.description: Controller-side pytest plugin that records completed node durations and worker loss.

artifacts.name: test_execution
artifacts.description: Opts this repository into duration-informed loadscope workers within one process budget.

artifacts.name: TestExecutionConfig
artifacts.description: Validated worker, threshold, command concurrency, and total-process policy.

artifacts.name: pytest_dist_mode
artifacts.description: Validated automatic scheduler; only loadscope is accepted until another mode has equivalent 121-03 evidence.

artifacts.name: accepted_pytest_worker_counts
artifacts.description: Worker counts with exact repository-wide 121-03 equivalence evidence; maid-runner configures eight.

artifacts.name: run_command
artifacts.description: Executes a resolved command with optional subprocess-scoped timing-plugin environment additions.

artifacts.name: run_tests
artifacts.description: Forwards worker policy into the cached repository path and returns deterministic results plus notices.

artifacts.name: run_manifest_tests
artifacts.description: Applies the same accepted worker/count policy to a single manifest and preserves exact command attribution.

artifacts.name: _run_tests_cached
artifacts.description: Resolves repository commands, accumulates typed notices, and passes the exact override to implementation-command execution.

artifacts.name: _run_implementation_commands
artifacts.description: Renders accepted worker flags before serial/parallel dispatch, appends one notice per group, and preserves existing result order.

artifacts.name: scheduling_notices
artifacts.description: Notices accumulated identically by repository, task-scoped, and single-manifest execution paths.

artifacts.name: _run_test_command
artifacts.description: Applies environment additions to one child only and never mutates the MAID process environment.

artifacts.name: build_parser
artifacts.description: Adds explicit pytest-worker options distinct from independent command jobs.

artifacts.name: cmd_test
artifacts.description: Forwards the explicit worker override to repository and --manifest execution paths.

artifacts.name: cmd_verify
artifacts.description: Forwards the explicit pytest worker override into the complete verify execution path.

artifacts.name: _run_verify
artifacts.description: Threads the exact worker override through the cached invocation without resolving it early.

artifacts.name: _run_verify_cached
artifacts.description: Passes the exact worker override to the tests stage for both repository and task-scoped plans.

artifacts.name: _tests_stage
artifacts.description: Applies the same worker override/notices to repository run_tests and the task-scoped direct implementation-command path.

artifacts.name: format_test_result
artifacts.description: Renders identical test results plus deterministic scheduling notices in text and JSON.
